title: DQ Rule Definition v1
description: Schema v1 for Data Quality rule definitions authored in the DQ Workspace.

schema_version.description: Schema version — must be 1 for v1 rules

name.description: Human-readable rule name (e.g. 'Monthly electricity must not be null')

description.description: What this rule checks, why it exists, and any context for reviewers

level.description: Rule level: 'field' = schema-bound deterministic check; 'business' = governance policy requiring domain knowledge

dimension.description: DAMA DMBOK2 data quality dimension this rule targets

type.description: Rule type — deterministic engine types: not_null, unique, allowed_values, range, regex, reference_integrity, threshold; AI-powered: nl_check, anomaly_detect

severity.description: Severity level: 'info' = advisory, 'warn' = requires attention, 'error' = blocking

active.description: Whether this rule is active and will be evaluated during DQ runs

bindings.description: Optional table/field bindings (rules are standalone — bindings applied at data product level, per ADR-0006)

field.description: Field name (optional — omit for table-level rules)

params.description: Rule-type-specific parameters. See DQ Workspace documentation for per-type params.

enforcement.description: Enforcement settings controlling when this rule is evaluated

on_write.description: If true, evaluate this rule on every data write (not supported for nl_check/anomaly_detect)
